(async () => { await window.raid.fresh(); await window.raid.hold(true); await window.raid.start(11, 0); await window.raid.taught(); await window.raid.bot(5); await window.raid.skip(2); await window.raid.plan(); await window.raid.skip(2); return await JSON.stringify(window.raid.state().choice); })()
(async () => { await window.raid.strip(); return await window.raid.party().filter(p => p.on === 'board').map(p => p.kind).join(' '); })()

(async ()=>{const r = window.raid; const board = r.party().filter(p => p.on === 'board'); const one = board[0]; const three = board[1]; await r.item('thorn'); r.hand('thorn', one.id); await r.settled(); for (const k of ['honeycake', 'mothlantern', 'stewpot']) { await r.item(k); r.hand(k, three.id); await r.settled(); } r.skip(0.6); return 'one: ' + one.kind + ', three: ' + three.kind + ', held: ' + JSON.stringify(r.held())})()
(()=>{const r = window.raid; const three = r.party().filter(p => p.on === 'board')[1]; const at = r.heldAt(three.id, 1); return at})()
(()=>{const r = window.raid; const p = r.party().filter(p => p.on === 'board')[1]; r.tap(p.id); r.skip(0.3); return 'pinned: ' + document.querySelector('.k-info.pinned .k-name')?.textContent})()

(async ()=>{const r = window.raid; const p = r.party().filter(p => p.on === 'board')[0]; await r.item('plume'); r.hover('plume', p.id); r.skip(0.5); return 'forging over ' + p.kind + ': ' + document.querySelector('.k-info .k-name')?.textContent})()
(async () => { await window.raid.drop(); await window.raid.to('component'); await window.raid.skip(1.5); return await JSON.stringify(window.raid.state().choice); })()
(async () => { await window.raid.item('glowcap'); await window.raid.skip(0.4); return await 'have tags: ' + document.querySelectorAll('#picks .k-info-tagged').length; })()

(()=>{const r = document.querySelector('#picks .makes.lit .k-thing:not(.bare)') ?? document.querySelector('#picks .makes .k-thing:not(.bare)'); const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x: b.left + b.width / 2, y: b.top + b.height / 2}})()
(async () => { await document.querySelector("[data-pick='0']").click(); await window.raid.settled(); return await 'took the first pick'; })()
(async () => { await window.raid.skip(1.5); await window.raid.plan(); await window.raid.fight(); await window.raid.busy(); return await 'a fight'; })()
